[b]February 13, 2028: Recall[/b]

The government of Rosenmarkke has formally requested the return of all senior defense and security officials in Rosenmarkke to the capital of Tharkønn, with the government giving no comment as to why the order had been made.

[b]February 14, 2028: The D-30 Doctrine[/b]

Following 24 hours of private meetings with senior defense and intelligence officials, the Chief Consuls office has formally released the D-30 Framework for a Brighter Future or [i]Project Sunshine[/i]

[b][i]Project Sunshine[/i][/b]

Where the state in 2027 maximised its authority, its power, and expanded its strength to ensure the successful implementation of the D-29 framework known as the Strømm Doctrine, reviews of the Strømm Doctrine as initially implemented have found it to be structurally insufficient for the needs of the state of Rosenmarkke in 2028. Thus under the order of the Triumvirate, the following changes shall be implemented, hereafter to be referred to as D-30.

[list]1. A coalition between the nations two political parties shall be formed as agreed, creating one united party to be called Party for Rosenmarkke. 
2. The SCSID shall assume full control of the Patriotic Defense Council, military procurement, and all other functions of military leadership to fulfill its designation as the State Committee for Security, Intelligence, and Defense.
3. All legislative committees are to be dissolved and replaced by committees for state affairs. 
4 . All labor unions are to be merged into a central labor authority known as the United Labor Comission consisting of the presidents and leaders of the various nationally recognised labor unions.
5. The Bank of Tharkønn shall be nationalised and its functions merged into a newly founded Federal Bank of Rosenmarkke, which shall have the powers of monetary policy control, bank regulation, currency issuance, and the various other functions of a central bank, independent of the triumvirate and legislative.

[b]February 18-20, 2028: The Emergency Dictatorship[/b]

Within the constitution of Rosenmarkke there exists a little known referendum based lever which was written in by the first triumvirate towards the end of their terms under the first triumvirate. It was a little referendum allowing the installation of the chief consul as temporary dictator, granting them the highest authorities and powers that are usually devolved to the other two consuls. However, such a motion had never been used until now.

Rumors had been circulating prior to the unveiling of D-30 that Strømm intended to utilise this mechanism to stabilise the state as it transitioned into the 6th Republic, however, these were merely rumors. That is until on February 17 the office of the triumvirate released an announcement declaring an emergency referendum to install a constitutional mandate into the executive.

Millions flooded into the ballot boxes in the days that followed, some frightened by the massive shift, others hopeful of change, and others seeking to voice their opposition to the measure.

Turnout of all legal adults was 46% a sign of a tired electorate, however, the results were all but clear. 52% of the electorate who voted agreed to the matter of installing the constitutional mandate, the rest dissented with nos. 

The apathy and tiredness what what the SCSID and Strømm needed.

Thus on February 20, 2028 the results were announced and in a solemn ceremony, Strømm was declared Dictator of Rosenmarkke term limited to a mere five months, unless the legislature convened another national referendum.

This time there was no sun imagery, no propaganda, just cold efficiency.
